title: One Honest Question That Builds Real Brotherhood
caption:
"You good?" isn't a question. It's a script you both already know the ending to.

Real brotherhood starts with a question that actually requires an answer, then a follow-up when he gives you the easy one. It grows when you go first with the honest stuff. It gets proven when you show up without being asked.

Text the guy this is for.

#faith #christianmen #brotherhood #community #manofgod
